text: Arthur Butz's The Hoax of the Twentieth Century was seized in 1984 by RCMP officers from the library of the University of Calgary under the Customs Tariff Act, and classified as “hate literature.” It was returned to the university's library shelves because customs officers had prohibited it after it entered the country. In 1995, the RCMP seized a copy from a public library in Didsbury (AB), and it was shredded before the librarian could respond because the RCMP said it was prohibited.
meta_description: The Hoax of the Twentieth Century by Arthur Butz: seized by the RCMP from a Calgary university library in 1984 and from a Didsbury library in 1995.
changes: Author added; 1984 and 1995 seizures kept with actor and statute.
